Name: Hill Country of Judah
ModernLocation: The hill country south of Jerusalem
Description: The upland region of Judah, including the country around Hebron and the villages south of Jerusalem. Mary went into this hill country to visit Elisabeth, and the news of John's birth spread through all of it.
BiblicalSignificance: The hill country of Judah is where the births of John the Baptist and Jesus were first spoken of among neighbors.
